reauth_confirm.title: Re-authorize DiapStash
reauth_confirm.description: Your DiapStash authorization has expired or is missing a permission (refresh tokens last 7 days without use). Make sure the scopes cloud-sync.history, cloud-sync.accidents and cloud-sync.types are enabled on your DiapStash API client, then click Submit to open the DiapStash login page and issue a new token.

abort.single_instance_allowed: DiapStash is already configured. Only one DiapStash account can be set up.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: OAuth authorisation was rejected by DiapStash.
abort.missing_configuration: The integration is not configured. Please follow the documentation.

init.title: DiapStash options
init.description: How often to poll DiapStash. Each update uses 2 of the 120 API requests per hour; if the remaining quota runs low, updates are slowed down automatically.
